Question
========
Under the BDSG, personal data may be used for archival, scientific, or statistical purposes if:

Answerlist
----------
* The data subject gives oral and written consent
* It is in the public interest and appropriate safeguards are implemented
* The data are older than five years
* The data are publicly available


Solution
========
Under the BDSG, personal data may be used for archival, scientific, or statistical purposes if it is in the public interest and appropriate safeguards are implemented.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
